The CPU is not involved in the GDMA transfer, and therefore it becomes more efficient with less workload.
The GDMA controller in ESP32-S3 has ten independent channels, i.e., five transmit channels and five receive channels.
These ten channels are shared by peripherals with GDMA feature, namely
You can assign the ten channels to any of these peripherals.
Every channel supports access to internal RAM or external RAM.
The GDMA controller uses fixed-priority and round-robin channel arbitration schemes to manage peripherals' needs for bandwidth.
